name: Henge (Tomba247 test builds)
subtitle: Unofficial Henge builds for testing
description: Test builds of Henge, macOS on iPhone and iPad, from github.com/Tomba247/Henge (a fork of Leviidev/Henge, GPL-2.0-or-later). Each build says which branch it came from. Henge needs JIT (StikJIT or StikDebug) and the increased-memory and extended-addressing entitlements, so sign it with a development certificate.

apps.name: Henge
apps.subtitle: macOS on your iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: Henge runs macOS on iPhone and iPad: a virtual machine with its own arm64 translator, emulated devices and Metal graphics. These are unofficial test builds; the branch name is at the start of each version's notes. Upstream: github.com/Leviidev/Henge.

versions.localizedDescription: [league-el0] iPhone mouse: switch on when the mouse moves (iOS 27 reports AssistiveTouch as off while it is on), and move the Mac's pointer by the mouse's own motion one to one, clamped to the screen as AssistiveTouch's is (Madeira's way), with the Mac's own pointer hidden

[league-el0] iPhone mouse as Madeira does it: the Mac's pointer goes where AssistiveTouch's is (USB absolute pointer, from hover and its taps), its copies of clicks are kept from the trackpad, and the Mac's own pointer is not drawn while the mouse is in use
[league-el0] The refresh time at +68 is written without the refresh event; the event (HV_PVG_VBLANK) is off unless switched on
[league-el0] Experiment: an 8192-entry software TLB (HV_TLB_BITS=13), half the cache footprint
[henge-perf] Shared folder: henge.log and henge-prev.log linked into it when a Mac starts
[henge-perf] translate: an exit stub holds only its slot's address; the target lives in the slot
[henge-perf] ios: drop the RemotePairingChoice.swift entry #176's project.yml brought in
[henge-perf] Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/perf-night' into merge-test
[league-el0] The profile setting also counts the translated instructions under each sample (HV_PROF_IOS=2, Documents/hvprof-words.txt)
[league-el0] Graphics: object type 12 (League of Legends' render targets) made as the GPU's own textures; without them its passes were skipped and nothing was drawn
[league-el0] SCTLR_EL1 writes at EL1 inline when M, WXN, E0E and EE stay as they are (xnu writes it on every kernel entry and exit of a process with other PAC keys: 586K a second with League running)
[league-el0] Merge upstream PR #155: the control pill tucks into a handle at the top when there is no room beside the Mac
[league-el0] Microphone: half a second kept when the Mac is late for a buffer (a tenth cut the sound: clicks, static); gaps counted; the first 15 s saved to Documents/mic-capture.raw
[league] Merge upstream PR #126: Scan for the OpenGL personality only on TTBR1 writes with the MMU off
[league-el0] Merge branch 'league' into league-el0
[league-el0] Trackpad: a held still press then moved drags (as Moonlight's trackpad mode); held still and lifted, it right-clicks
[league] The refresh time at +68 of the display page, where AppleParavirtDisplay reads it (found in macOS 15.6.1's kernelcache)
[league-el0] The refresh time at +68 of the display page, where AppleParavirtDisplay reads it (found in macOS 15.6.1's kernelcache)
[league-el0] Experimental: the refresh event's time on the Mac's clock at +108 of the display page (HV_PVG_VSYNC_TS)
[league] Log what the Mac keeps in the display page around refresh events (WindowServer's display timer reads a refresh time of 0)
[league-el0] Experimental: direct app memory off by default (on the phone it made the Mac 5-10x slower: 60% of the time in page faults)
[league-el0] Experimental: direct app memory tries smaller windows when 16 GB a CPU does not fit (the phone refused the fourth)
[league-el0] Experimental: direct app memory (upstream #157 prototype), boot crash fixed
[league] Each build is numbered a small step past upstream's, released, and listed in the app source
